tools.description: Resolve a taxon name (scientific, common or alias) to the canonical taxon_id used elsewhere. Prefer to call this first and reuse the returned taxon_id in later calls. Returns one of the library's canonical outcomes (see schema/outcome.schema.json in the engine repository). If the status is not 'ok' or 'ok_category' (e.g. 'unknown', 'insufficient_input', 'not_applicable', 'refer_to_label', 'refer_to_authority', 'ambiguous'), report it to the user verbatim. Do not invent a number or a category. Results are advisory, not for direct actuation.
tools.name: resolve_taxon

language.description: Optional BCP-47 language tag (e.g. 'id', 'en') to narrow alias matching. Null means any language.

name.description: Taxon name to resolve. Up to 200 characters.

tools.description: Read one fact (a single agronomic value) for a taxon from the loaded knowledge pack. Returns the value at the highest-priority scope that matches the caller's context, with provenance. Values at or below the effective status floor are refused. Returns one of the library's canonical outcomes (see schema/outcome.schema.json in the engine repository). If the status is not 'ok' or 'ok_category' (e.g. 'unknown', 'insufficient_input', 'not_applicable', 'refer_to_label', 'refer_to_authority', 'ambiguous'), report it to the user verbatim. Do not invent a number or a category. Results are advisory, not for direct actuation.
tools.name: resolve_fact

country.description: Optional ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code to constrain the scope. Null means any scope.

parameter.description: Dictionary key, e.g. 'soil_ph', 'gdd_base', 'kc', 'n_fertilizer_rate'. Must exist in the pack's dictionary.

phase.description: Optional growth phase. Only set for parameters whose phase_set is 'biological' or 'kc'. Null when the parameter is not phased.

system.description: Optional growing system ('field', 'container', 'paddy'). Null means any system.

tools.description: Classify a numeric value (temperature, pH, EC, etc.) against the trapezoid thresholds recorded for a parameter and a taxon. Returns 'optimal', 'suboptimal' or 'critical' with the breakpoints used. Returns one of the library's canonical outcomes (see schema/outcome.schema.json in the engine repository). If the status is not 'ok' or 'ok_category' (e.g. 'unknown', 'insufficient_input', 'not_applicable', 'refer_to_label', 'refer_to_authority', 'ambiguous'), report it to the user verbatim. tools.name: threshold_check

parameter.description: Dictionary key for the trapezoid, e.g. 'soil_ph', 'air_temp_day'.

phase.description: Optional growth phase. Null when the parameter is not phased.

unit.description: Unit of 'value'. Must match the parameter's dictionary unit.

value.description: The value to classify, in the parameter's unit.

tools.description: Determine the current growth stage of a taxon. Requires the caller to pick a mode and fill only the mode-specific fields; the host validates that the combination is consistent. Returns one of the library's canonical outcomes (see schema/outcome.schema.json in the engine repository). If the status is not 'ok' or 'ok_category' (e.g. 'unknown', 'insufficient_input', 'not_applicable', 'refer_to_label', 'refer_to_authority', 'ambiguous'), report it to the user verbatim. tools.name: stage_resolve

age_days.description: Required when mode='age'. Days since the reference date. Must be >= 0. Ignored otherwise.

events.description: Required when mode='events'. Comma-separated list of observed event codes, e.g. 'budbreak,flowering'. Ignored otherwise.

mode.description: How the stage is determined. 'age' = days since sowing or transplant; 'thermal' = accumulated thermal time; 'events' = caller-supplied event log (perennial).

thermal_time.description: Required when mode='thermal'. Accumulated thermal time in degree-days. Ignored otherwise.

tools.description: Evaluate whether a site (soil pH, EC, air temperature, relative humidity, VPD, DLI) is suitable for a taxon at a given phase. phase.description: Optional growth phase. Null evaluates against any phase the taxon carries.
